uniform_reference_objective: Existing repository float32 space_weak objective, evaluated at each saved CUDA-trained model with all six original default weights; CPU evaluation only

cross_device_component_verification.criterion: abs(CPU-common-form component - native-CUDA raw component) <= atol + rtol*abs(native)
cross_device_component_verification.scope: Fixed float32 cross-device evaluation check, not a roundoff theorem or optimizer convergence test; a failure stops report completion

native_objective_policy: Post-update native total_loss can be compared across budgets within the same objective arm. It is not used to rank different loss weight vectors.
cpu_cohort_policy: CPU680 epoch150 is a separate complete weight/interaction cohort. No CPU endpoint or interrupted CPU continuation enters CUDA budget lines.
selection: All declared seeds, variants and checkpoints; no true-error-based selection
uncertainty: Mean and sample SD across five paired seeds; paired differences use descriptive Student-t 95% intervals
